CREATE TABLE known_users (
	telegram_id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(64), 
	full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (telegram_id)
)

CREATE TABLE operators (
	telegram_id BIGSERIAL NOT NULL, 
	role operator_role NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (telegram_id)
)

CREATE TABLE telegram_accounts (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	display_number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	telegram_user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_session TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status account_status NOT NULL, 
	error_streak INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	last_error_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_proxy_id INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (phone)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_telegram_accounts_telegram_user_id ON telegram_accounts (telegram_user_id)

CREATE TABLE proxies (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	protocol proxy_protocol NOT NULL, 
	host VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	port INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	login VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	encrypted_password TEXT NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	last_check_ok BOOLEAN, 
	last_checked_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_proxy_endpoint UNIQUE (protocol, host, port, login)
)

CREATE TABLE channels (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	username VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	permanent BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	check_interval_seconds INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_cycle_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_by BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_channels_username ON channels (username)

CREATE TABLE jobs (
	id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	mode job_mode NOT NULL, 
	status job_status NOT NULL, 
	created_by BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	duration_minutes INTEGER, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	ends_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	summary JSON, 
	report_path TEXT, 
	deletion_reminded_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id)
)

CREATE TABLE system_settings (
	key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	value JSON NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (key)
)

CREATE TABLE account_channel_subscriptions (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	subscribed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	unsubscribed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	last_error TEXT, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_account_channel_subscription UNIQUE (account_id, channel_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES telegram_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(channel_id) REFERENCES channels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE account_progress (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_viewed_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_full_scan_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	total_registered BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_account_channel_progress UNIQUE (account_id, channel_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES telegram_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(channel_id) REFERENCES channels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE job_channels (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_job_channel UNIQUE (job_id, channel_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(channel_id) REFERENCES channels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE account_job_results (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	job_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL, 
	account_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	proxy_id INTEGER, 
	status result_status NOT NULL, 
	available_posts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	viewed_posts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	last_message_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	error TEXT, 
	started_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	finished_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_job_account_channel_result UNIQUE (job_id, account_id, channel_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(job_id) REFERENCES jobs (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES telegram_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(channel_id) REFERENCES channels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(proxy_id) REFERENCES proxies (id) ON DELETE SET NULL
)

CREATE TABLE schedules (
	id SERIAL NOT NULL, 
	channel_id INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind schedule_kind NOT NULL, 
	run_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	interval_minutes INTEGER, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_by BIGINT NOT NULL, 
	last_run_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(channel_id) REFERENCES channels (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
